data.summary: Created usaspending-assess Python package that productizes the E206 integrated CLI tool. Package provides assess-pcc command to assess any USAspending PSC code for small-team software entry. Key metrics verified: 7030 (32.1% ≤0k, 65% software, 3,916 recipients, 53.3% survival) and DA10 (27.1% ≤0k, 57.8% software, 72.6% survival, 28% GSA MAS small vendor share). Prototype enables small software teams to assess PSC codes without needing to run the full E206 analysis pipeline manually. Package installed via pip install . and uses only standard library. All code is preservable in git.
